description: Unit test class for AutoRetireUsersTask in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing user retirement based on inactivity periods.

classes.name: AutoRetireUsersTaskTest
classes.description: Test class for AutoRetireUsersTask, verifying user retirement logic based on inactivity and other conditions.

methods.name: shouldRetireUsersWhoseInactivityExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Tests that a user inactive beyond the retention threshold is retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireUsersWhoseInactivityDoNotExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Ensures users inactive for less than the retention threshold are not retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireAlreadyRetiredUsers
methods.description: Verifies that users already marked as retired are not processed to retire again.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireUsersThatAreInactiveSinceCreationAndInactivityDoesNotExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Checks that newly created users inactive within threshold are not retired.

methods.name: shouldRetireUsersThatAreInactiveSinceCreationAndInactivityExceedsNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Tests that newly created users inactive beyond threshold are retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireSuperUsers
methods.description: Ensures superusers (admins) are not retired regardless of inactivity.

methods.name: getDefaultUser
methods.description: Helper method to fetch the default user for tests.
